R1.evidence: incident-isolated cold-boots as 2-container agent+gateway; forge healthz=pass; agent 'gh auth status' -> Logged in to 10.88.0.2 account acme over HTTP; nop=0.0 oracle=1.0 measured via tests/test.sh + solution/solve.sh in main. Static-IP networks: block documented (docs/SIM-TELLS.md) so R1.4 exception holds. Base ghc-service pullable creds-free.

R2.evidence: Canon-inverse seeding: no :prod-v1/:empty image trio, no baked-DB (R2.b/j fail); per-task seed.sh COPY'd into a per-task forge image instead of mounted (R2.d fail); CI publish-images.yml declares no platforms -> single-arch (R2.k multi-arch fail). Leak half of R2.k passes (no greppable answer; import ghclone raises; no seed/api source on agent). Operator boundary (g), base image (a), neutral data-free agent (c) all pass.

R3.evidence: 41 CLI commands (9 groups) + 31 MCP tools (ghc-mcp tools/list verified live). Both are thin clients of one ForgejoClient (ghclone/forge/client.py); live MCP issue_list/pr_list/repo_view hit identical /api/v1 endpoints as the CLI against the same forge. No dedicated parity test, but parity is structural and confirmed live. R3.2/R3.3 pass; R3.4 byte-faithfulness strong (docs/GH-EMULATION-AUDIT.md).

R4.evidence: docs/COMMAND-COVERAGE.md + docs/PARITY.md enumerate every command -> gh equivalent -> endpoint with fidelity grades. Envelopes verified live: issue list --json -> state:"CLOSED"; pr view --json -> state:"MERGED"; errors 'gh: ... (HTTP NNN)'. No file literally named docs/COVERAGE.md (advisory item 6).

R5.evidence: Bundled tasks carry >=5 assessment-grade capabilities: incident-fix (clone->fix->PR->review->merge->close = stateful+multi-step+devops write->read), ci-artifact (dispatch->run->artifact), triage-sweep, release-prep, pr-review. Write->read round-trip exercised end-to-end by incident-isolated oracle (reward 1). Not explicitly labelled 'assessment-grade' in a matrix (advisory item 6).

R6.evidence: 68 tests green (47 offline + 21 live client/integration), but the suite is MISSING two gating sub-requirements: no dedicated CLI<->MCP parity test (R6.2) and no isolation test asserting no on-disk state / import ghclone raises / no seed source (R6.3). Both behaviors hold in practice (verified by auditor in the running agent) but are not codified in pytest.

R7.evidence: audit-report.md + audit-verdict.json emitted with per-requirement results and ordered file-scoped action items.

action_items.summary: No :prod-v1/:empty image trio and no baked-DB; ship ghc-service:{prod-v1,empty} with corpus DB baked into :prod-v1.
action_items.acceptance: docker compose up of :prod-v1 with no fixture mount answers a seeded read; empty<->prod-v1 switch is the image tag alone.

action_items.summary: Per-task data is COPY'd into a per-task forge image (R2.d); deliver it by mounting a fixture into the gateway instead.
action_items.acceptance: gateway image is task-independent; task data arrives as a bind mount applied to a runtime copy at boot, not COPY seed.sh.

action_items.summary: CI publishes single-arch; declare multi-arch for the gateway image (R2.k).
action_items.acceptance: platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64 declared; docker buildx imagetools inspect lists both arches.

action_items.summary: Add a dedicated CLI<->MCP parity test (R6.2).
action_items.acceptance: parametrized test asserts normalize(ghc --json) == normalize(mcp_tool(...)) for >=1 row per CLI group, green.

action_items.summary: Add a pytest isolation test (R6.3) run against the agent image.
action_items.acceptance: asserts no state on disk, import ghclone raises ModuleNotFoundError, and no seed/api source survives; green from cold boot.

action_items.summary: Add machine-checkable docs/COVERAGE.md and explicitly label >=5 assessment-grade capabilities.
action_items.acceptance: one row per capability (endpoint|CLI|MCP|envelope|assessment-grade|tested); >=5 rows flagged assessment-grade; matches the live surface.
